description: Black-and-white: bride holding a small dog in a bow tie, groom beside her, outdoors. Pets at weddings, elopements, candid moments.
Close-up of the groom placing the ring on the bride's finger during the ceremony; officiant blurred behind. Ceremony, vows, rings, timeline.
Bride and groom walking a sandy path through sea oats on a Florida beach. Beach weddings, humidity, wind, outdoor portraits.
Maureen applying powder to her own cheek with a brush while holding a compact. Setting makeup, powder, long-wear, touch-ups.
Bright salon shelving with hair-care products and framed art. Hair care, product routines, salon visits.
Two hair-spray / dry-shampoo cans on a white surface. Hair hold, dry shampoo, styling products, hair prep.
Flatlay on white marble: hair product, pink tint brush, small inspiration photo card. Hair color, glossing, pre-wedding hair appointments.
Artist styling a bride's long, voluminous half-up waves from behind; bride in a white robe. Half-up hair, long hair, getting ready.
Artist curling a woman's long brown hair in a light studio (landscape). Curls that last, hair prep, bridesmaid hair.
Close crop of a bride holding a colorful wildflower bouquet against her white gown; no face. Florals, color palette, details.
Small white buttercream cake on a gold tray with champagne and florals. Reception, budget, small weddings, celebrations.
Close-up of a pastel wildflower bouquet. Spring/summer weddings, florals, color stories.
Black-and-white close-up of the couple's hands showing the wedding ring. Nails/manicure, rings, details.
Smiling bride with long curly hair holding a colorful wildflower bouquet outdoors. Curly hair, natural makeup, joyful portraits.
Maureen applying makeup to a blonde woman in a bright getting-ready room. Bridal makeup application, skin prep, bridesmaids.
Black-and-white: two artists finishing a bride's hair while she checks her phone. Getting-ready timeline, candid prep moments.
Maureen, with bangs and a cream blazer, checking her makeup in a compact mirror. Touch-ups, makeup longevity, what to pack.
Woman adjusting a bride's short veil outdoors; bride in a short white dress. Courthouse weddings, rehearsal, second looks, veils.
Black-and-white: artist placing a bride's veil in a getting-ready room. Veil placement, final touches, accessories.
Bridal suite with a chandelier and pressed-tin ceiling; bride in a robe while an artist styles her hair. Venue getting-ready rooms, space and lighting.
Maureen portrait with full glam makeup, berry lip, long waves, black leather jacket. Bold lips, evening/fall glam, makeup trends.
Artist styling a smiling woman's hair as she holds a mimosa, floral wallpaper behind. Bridal party morning, relaxed getting ready, schedules.
Two artists finishing a bride's low updo with a jeweled hairpiece (landscape). Updos, hair accessories, veils.
Hands arranging makeup brushes, sponge, and products on a white table. Makeup kits, products, tools, skincare.
Flatlay of a 'Bride' pouch with lashes, beauty products, and small essentials (landscape). Emergency kits, what to pack, touch-ups.
Flatlay of a hair dryer and styling products. Blowouts, hair prep at home, tools.
Two artists working at once on a red-haired bride in a satin robe, one curling, one on makeup (landscape). Team timing, schedules, bridal party size.
Artist braiding and pinning a red-haired bride's hair; bride in a satin robe (landscape). Braids, boho hair, fine or thin hair.
